n653cc9a34c.headline: Communist Vostrá Pleased Schillerová: The Budget Is OK, a Deficit of 40 Billion Does Not Matter
n653cc9a34c.summary: The Czech Communist Party will recommend supporting the state budget proposal for next year, which includes a deficit of 40 billion crowns.
n653cc9a34c.why: The state budget and its deficit levels influence fiscal policy, government spending, and economic growth prospects in the Czech Republic.
